samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Implements a 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand input signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier input signal.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size" value="4"/> <!-- Parameter constant 'size' with value 4 -->
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="A_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extends the multiplicand (mul_a) by adding zeros at the most significant bits.</assign>
        <assign id="B_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extends the multiplier (mul_b) by adding zeros at the most significant bits.</assign>
        <assign id="partial_products" width_description="[7:0][3:0]">Stores the generated partial products based on the multiplier's bits.</assign>
        <assign id="reg_sum" width_description="[7:0][3:0]">Registers to store intermediate sums during the addition stage.</assign>
        <assign id="product" width_description="[7:0]">Stores the final product result.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Extends the inputs by adding zeros at the most significant bits.
        Generates partial products based on the multiplier's bits.
        Registers to store intermediate sums during the addition stage.
        Calculates the final product on the positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal.
    </implementation>
    <task id="extend_input">
        <description>Extends the input signal by adding zeros at the most significant bits.</description>
        <param_in id="signal" width_description="[size-1:0]"/>
        <param_out id="extended_signal" width_description="[2*size-1:0]"/>
        <step id="step1">
            <code>assign extended_signal = { {(size){1'b0}}, signal};</code>
        </step>
    </task>
    <task id="generate_partial_products">
        <description>Generates partial products based on the multiplier's bits.</description>
        <param_in id="A_ext" width_description="[2*size-1:0]"/>
        <param_in id="B_ext" width_description="[2*size-1:0]"/>
        <param_out id="partial_products" width_description="[2*size-1:0][size-1:0]"/>
        <for loop_id="i" start="0" end="size-1">
            <if condition="B_ext[i]==1'b1">
                <step id="step1">
                    <code>assign partial_products[i] = A_ext << i;</code>
                </step>
            </if>
            <else>
                <step id="step2">
                    <code>assign partial_products[i] = 'd0;</code>
                </step>
            </else>
        </for>
    </task>
    <task id="add_partial_products">
        <description>Adds partial products stored in registers.</description>
        <param_in id="partial_products" width_description="[2*size-1:0][size-1:0]"/>
        <param_in id="reg_sum" width_description="[2*size-1:0][size-1:0]"/>
        <param_out id="sum" width_description="[2*size-1:0]"/>
        <step id="step1">
            <code>assign sum = reg_sum[0] + reg_sum[1] + reg_sum[2] + reg_sum[3];</code>
        </step>
    </task>
    <task id="calculate_product">
        <description>Calculates the final product.</description>
        <param_in id="reg_sum" width_description="[2*size-1:0][size-1:0]"/>
        <param_out id="product" width_description="[2*size-1:0]"/>
        <step id="step1">
            <code>assign product = reg_sum[0] + reg_sum[1] + reg_sum[2] + reg_sum[3];</code>
        </step>
    </task>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <call_task id="extend_input_task" task_name="extend_input" param_in_mul_a="mul_a" param_out_A_ext="A_ext" />
        <call_task id="extend_input_task2" task_name="extend_input" param_in_mul_b="mul_b" param_out_B_ext="B_ext" />
        <call_task id="generate_partial_products_task" task_name="generate_partial_products" param_in_A_ext="A_ext" param_in_B_ext="B_ext" param_out_partial_products="partial_products" />
        <call_task id="add_partial_products_task" task_name="add_partial_products" param_in_partial_products="partial_products" param_in_reg_sum="reg_sum" param_out_sum="sum" />
        <call_task id="calculate_product_task" task_name="calculate_product" param_in_reg_sum="reg_sum" param_out_product="product" />
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <always_event id="always1" event_type="posedge" event_source="clk" event_condition="or rst_n">
            <if condition="!rst_n">
                <step id="reset_reg_sum">
                    <code>reg_sum <= 'd0;</code>
                </step>
            </if>
            <else>
                <step id="update_reg_sum">
                    <code>reg_sum <= sum;</code>
                </step>
            </else>
        </always_event>
        <always_event id="always2" event_type="posedge" event_source="clk" event_condition="or rst_n">
            <if condition="!rst_n">
                <step id="reset_product">
                    <code>product <= 'd0;</code>
                </step>
            </if>
            <else>
                <step id="update_product">
                    <code>product <= sum;</code>
                </step>
            </else>
        </always_event>
    </logic_description>
</module>
